CustomField.description: Snapshot of the Opportunity's Lead Source at the moment the record was created (including via Lead conversion). Owner: Marketing Ops. Populated once by the "Opportunity - Capture Original Lead Source" before-save flow and never updated again — use this field, not the standard Lead Source field, for source-attribution reporting.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Read-only historical record of the Lead Source captured when this Opportunity was created. The standard Lead Source field above can be changed later by reps; this field cannot. Marketing reporting should use this field.
CustomField.label: Original Lead Source
